title: The baseline: the trivial rule the model has to beat

videos.script: A model scores ninety-four per cent. {{score}} Is that good? Here is another model. It answers stay, for everybody, every month. It also scores ninety-four per cent. {{dummy}} So the number alone says nothing. It means something only beside what a simpler thing would have got. {{beside}} That simpler thing is the baseline. And it is built first. In this lesson you build three. A constant. A rule a person would write. And a first model, treated as a box. {{three}} The rule is chosen honestly, on months it may learn from. Then it meets six months it never saw, and loses money. {{rule}} The model makes twenty-one thousand reais over the same months. {{model}} And then one more question. Was that skill, or luck? You answer it by resampling the subscribers, a thousand times. {{bootstrap}} By the end, you know what any model in this course has to beat. And by how much it could ever win. {{end}}
